meta.title: 见微知著 · Newswire
meta.description: See the small signs, know where they lead. News from dozens of Chinese and international outlets, read by a language model and laid out as a newspaper-style edition: one storyline per event, every sentence cited and fact-checked. Track companies, technologies and situations over time with impact and outlook analysis, and get the important parts pushed to your phone at your pace. Works with no model calls too.
